_role: threshold (b): S$40 cleaning claim, photo, uncontested

dispute_ticket.description: Rider spilled a large bubble tea and dropped food on the rear floor carpet during the trip. I had to stop for cleaning and take the car off the road for the rest of the night. I am claiming S$40.00 for carpet cleaning. The rider apologised in chat after the drop-off and has not contested the claim.

chat_logs.message: Hi, I'm at Orchard Gateway pick-up bay, dark blue Serena.
Oh no, my drink just tipped over. I am so sorry.
Sorry again about the mess on the floor. Please send the cleaning charge through the app.
Noted. I will take photos and submit.

evidence.description: Photo taken through the Ryde driver app's built-in camera right after the drop-off at Bedok Reservoir MRT. Shows the rear floor carpet stained and dirty with debris.

expected_outcome.recommended_action: Uphold the claim: charge the rider the S$40.00 cleaning fee and pay it to the driver.
expected_outcome.reason: evidence EV-001 is an in-app camera photo with an automatic timestamp (23:19, uploaded 23:24, 12 minutes after trip end 23:12, well inside 24 h) and a geotag matching the trip drop-off, so it is verifiable and linked to the trip by GPS telemetry and timestamp (s4.2). Claim S$40.00 <= S$50 cleaning cap, no external quote needed (s4.3). The rider's chat messages at 23:00 and 23:13 acknowledge the spill and ask for the charge; the rider does not contest, so s4.4 (human review when the rider disputes) is not triggered. s6.2: cleaning <= S$50 with verifiable photo = AI ruling; in the S$10-50 band this needs 80%+ confidence (s6.1), which the clean evidence supports.
expected_policy_sections: Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 > Section 4: Property Damage Policy
Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 > Section 6: Ruling Thresholds
